captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable clip-on tag designed for the rim of a tumbler or drinking glass. It features an asymmetrical, wedge-shaped clip profile with two flat downward-extending walls of unequal heights. The design forms a tapered V-shaped inner gap that allows it to wedge securely onto rims of varying thicknesses.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable tumbler rim tag in OpenSCAD with a clip-on design. Provide parameters for the maximum and minimum glass thickness (GLASS_MAX and GLASS_MIN), the overall tag height (HEIGHT), the tag width (WIDTH), and the wall thickness (WALL). Ensure the profile is generated dynamically and extruded to the specified width.
captions.factory: The script defines a 2D helper module 'halfed_outline' using the polygon primitive to draw one side of the clip profile based on GLASS_MAX, GLASS_MIN, and WALL parameters. It then uses union, mirror, and linear_extrude to combine two instances of this profile (one scaled to 70% height and mirrored) into a single 3D clip of width 'WIDTH'.
